rca_of_issue: Bug: editMember and setEditMember were referenced in UnifiedPeoplePage.jsx but never declared as useState. Fix: Added `const [editMember, setEditMember] = useState(null);` at line 142. This was a simple missing state declaration that caused the edit member functionality to fail.
